description.value:
Every Saint learns the same truth on the edge of defeat: the more you are hurt, the brighter you burn. As the fight turns against you, your cosmo climbs — and the wounds that should end you become the fuel that answers back.

You gain a rising bonus that starts at 0 and increases by 1 each time you are critically hit, are reduced to half your Hit Points or lower for the first time, or are reduced to 0 Hit Points, to a maximum of +3. It resets at the end of the encounter or after a 10-minute rest.

While the rising bonus is at least +1, you gain that value as a status bonus to unarmed Strike damage and to your Technique DCs. At +2 or more you also gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. At +3, once per round you may Step or Stride 5 feet as a free action when you take damage — the cosmo will not let you simply stand and fall.

Special On any day your Cloth's constellation is ascendant or Exalted, your rising bonus starts each encounter at +1 rather than 0. Your cosmo is already lit before the first blow lands.
